# Add Vendor

## Stepwise Guide

Log in to the software entering your username and password

1.  In the left sidebar menu, go to ‘Vendor> Add New’.

    ![](https://learn.udyogx.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/add-vendor.png)

2.  A form will open where you can fill the Vendor details.
3.  Fill out the Client form such as '',  'Business Name', 'Business Address', 'GSTIN', 'Pan No', 'Email', 'Phone Number', 'Region', 'Business Info', 'Business Account Info' and all field.
4.  After filling the details click on 'Save' button at the bottom.  

    ![](https://learn.udyogx.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/add-vendor-2.png)

5.  You can see the new vendor would show in the Vendor List.
